# See https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/wiki/Configuration-Examples:-patterns

^\s*(?:-[-\[\]\w?]*\|?)+\)$

\{\d+:(?!-).*?\}

^\s*Assert\..*

HTTP(?=[a-z])

\[InlineData\(.*\]

SecretMasker.AddValue\(".*"

pathExt = ".*"

# src/Misc/layoutbin/hashFiles/index.js
^// a\{.*

# Public strings
public const string [A-Z]\w+ = ".+"

# Date formats
DateTime\.UtcNow\.ToString\("[^"]{2,}?"\)

# Automatically suggested patterns

# hit-count: 3750 file-count: 467
# IServiceProvider / isAThing
(?:(?:\b|_|(?<=[a-z]))[ITX]|(?:\b|_)(?:nsI|isA))(?=(?:[A-Z][a-z]{2,})+(?:[A-Z\d]|\b))

# hit-count: 481 file-count: 341
# C# includes
^\s*using [^;]+;

# hit-count: 445 file-count: 193
# https/http/file urls
(?:\b(?:https?|ftp|file)://)[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%?=~_|!:,.;]+[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%=~_|]

# hit-count: 209 file-count: 9
# hex digits including css/html color classes:
(?:[\\0][xX]|\\u\{?|[uU]\+|#x?|%23|&H)[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*?[a-fA-FgGrR]{2,}[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*(?:[uUlL]{0,3}|[iu]\d+)\b

# hit-count: 110 file-count: 17
# uuid:
\b[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-){3}[0-9a-fA-F]{12}\b

# hit-count: 52 file-count: 4
# regex choice
\((?:\?:|)[^)|]+(?<! )\|(?!(?:jq|xargs)\b)[^)| ][^)]*\)

# hit-count: 50 file-count: 5
# Library prefix
# e.g., `lib`+`archive`, `lib`+`raw`, `lib`+`unwind`
# (ignores some words that happen to start with `lib`)
(?:\b|_)[Ll]ib(?!era[lt])(?:re(?=office)|era|)(?!ero|erty|rar(?:i(?:an|es)|y))(?=[a-z])

# hit-count: 25 file-count: 10
# tar arguments
\b(?:\\n|)g?tar(?:\.exe|)(?:\s-C \S+|(?:\s+--[-a-zA-Z]+|\s+-[a-zA-Z]+|\s[ABGJMOPRSUWZacdfh-pr-xz]+\b)(?:=[^ ]*|))+

# hit-count: 22 file-count: 7
# version suffix <word>v#
(?:(?<=[A-Z]{2})V|(?<=[a-z]{2}|[A-Z]{2})v)\d+(?:\b|(?=[a-zA-Z_]))

# hit-count: 20 file-count: 4
# hex runs
\b(?=(?:[a-fA-F]{0,2}\d)*[a-fA-F]{3})[0-9a-fA-F]{16,}\b

# hit-count: 13 file-count: 10
# base64 encoded content, possibly wrapped in mime
(?:^# )[-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+]{50,}(?:[\s=;:?]|$)

# hit-count: 13 file-count: 5
# alternate printf markers if you run into latex and friends
(?<!\\)\\[nr](?=[a-z]{2,})(?=.*['"`])

# hit-count: 13 file-count: 3
# javascript replace regex
\.replace\(/[^/\s"]{3,}/[gim]*\s*,

# hit-count: 10 file-count: 1
# tput arguments -- https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/terminfo.5.html -- technically they can be more than 5 chars long...
\btput\s+(?:(?:-[SV]|-T\s*\w+)\s+)*\w{3,5}\b

# hit-count: 8 file-count: 1
# base64 encoded json
\beyJ[-a-zA-Z=;:/0-9+]+

# hit-count: 6 file-count: 3
# URL escaped characters
%[0-9A-F][A-F](?=[A-Za-z])

# hit-count: 5 file-count: 4
# GitHub actions
\buses:\s+(['"]?)[-\w.]+/[-\w./]+@[-\w.]+\g{-1}

# hit-count: 2 file-count: 1
# ANSI color codes
(?:\\(?:u00|x)1[Bb]|\\03[1-7]|\x1b|\\u\{1[Bb]\})\[(?:\d+(?:;\d+)*|)m

# hit-count: 2 file-count: 1
# Docker images
^\s*(?i)FROM\s+\S+:\S+(?:\s+AS\s+\S+|)

# hit-count: 2 file-count: 1
# JavaScript regular expressions
# javascript exec/test regex
/.{3,}?/[gim]*\.(?:exec|test)\(

# hit-count: 2 file-count: 1
# javascript match regex
\.match\(/[^/\s"]{3,}/[gim]*\s*

# hit-count: 2 file-count: 1
# curl arguments
\b(?:\\n|)curl(?:\.exe|)(?:\s+-[a-zA-Z]{1,2}\b)*(?:\s+-[a-zA-Z]{3,})(?:\s+-[a-zA-Z]+)*

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# getopts
\bgetopts\s+(?:"[^"]+"|'[^']+')

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# node packages
(["'])@[^/'" ]+/[^/'" ]+\g{-1}

# hit-count: 1 file-count: 1
# microsoft
\b(?:https?://|)(?:(?:(?:blogs|download\.visualstudio|docs|msdn2?|research)\.|)microsoft|blogs\.msdn)\.co(?:m|\.\w\w)/[-_a-zA-Z0-9()=./%]*

# Questionably acceptable forms of `in to`
# Personally, I prefer `log into`, but people object
# https://www.tprteaching.com/log-into-log-in-to-login/
\b(?:(?:[Ll]og(?:g(?=[a-z])|)|[Ss]ign)(?:ed|ing)?) in to\b

# to opt in
\bto opt in\b

# pass(ed|ing) in
\bpass(?:ed|ing) in\b

# acceptable duplicates
# ls directory listings
[-bcdlpsw](?:[-r][-w][-SsTtx]){3}[\.+*]?\s+\d+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+[.\d]+(?:[KMGT]|)\s+
# mount
\bmount\s+-t\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\b
# C types and repeated CSS values
\s(auto|await|buffalo|center|div|inherit|long|LONG|none|normal|solid|String|thin|transparent|very|yield)(?:\s\g{-1})+\s
# C enum and struct
\b(?:enum|struct)\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\b
# go templates
\s(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\s+\`(?:graphql|inject|json|yaml):
# doxygen / javadoc / .net
(?:[\\@](?:brief|defgroup|groupname|link|t?param|return|retval)|(?:public|private|internal|\[Parameter(?:\(.+\)|)\])(?:\s+(?:static|override|readonly|required|virtual))*)(?:\s+\{\w+\}|)\s+(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\s
# C# getter/setter
\s(\w+)\s+\g{-1}\s*\{\s*[gs]et;

# macOS file path
(?:Contents\W+|(?!iOS)/)MacOS\b

# Python package registry has incorrect spelling for macOS / Mac OS X
"Operating System :: MacOS :: MacOS X"

# "company" in Germany
\bGmbH\b

# IntelliJ
\bIntelliJ\b

# Commit message -- Signed-off-by and friends
^\s*(?:(?:Based-on-patch|Co-authored|Helped|Mentored|Reported|Reviewed|Signed-off)-by|Thanks-to): (?:[^<]*<[^>]*>|[^<]*)\s*$

# Autogenerated revert commit message
^This reverts commit [0-9a-f]{40}\.$

# ignore long runs of a single character:
\b([A-Za-z])\g{-1}{3,}\b
